title: When a payment link cannot be made, the message says show the UPI QR or try again, but neither button is there
what: On Collect payment or Sell membership, tapping Make a payment link when the link cannot be made (for example the member has no mobile number) shows 'Show the UPI QR instead, or try again'. The box has now switched to the link view, so the Show UPI QR and Make a payment link buttons are hidden and nothing replaces them. Once any link is on screen there is also no way back to the UPI QR.
expected: After a failed or open link, the desk still sees Show UPI QR and Try again (or a Back), so the money can still be taken on the same sheet.
how_often: every time a payment link fails
fix_line: Keep the UPI QR and try-again buttons showing when a link fails, and add a Back from the link view

title: Moving through the branch list with the arrow keys opens each branch in turn
what: The branch picker at the top switches branch the moment its choice changes. With the keyboard, in common Windows browsers each arrow press on the closed list changes the choice, so the owner is thrown into the first branch passed and sent to the home page, before reaching the one wanted.
expected: A keyboard user can move through the branches and only opens one on Enter, or the picker is a list of buttons.
how_often: every keyboard use of the picker
fix_line: Open the branch only on a confirmed pick, not on every change of the list

title: Open payments, the move notice buttons and the branch picker are smaller than the panel's finger-size rule
what: The panel's own rule is 44 points for anything tapped. The Open payments link under the Pay online box has no padding, so it is only as tall as its 13-point words. The OK and Open now buttons on the moving-address notice are about 31 points tall, and the branch picker is 40.
expected: Every one of these is at least 44 points tall.
who: owners and front desk on phones
fix_line: Give these three controls the same 44-point height as the panel's buttons

title: A screen reader is not told the result of a branch member search
what: After Find on 'Member from another branch', and while typing in 'Find a member in any branch', the result or the 'No member ... has this number' line appears on screen but is not announced, so a screen-reader user hears nothing after the search.
expected: The result line, or how many were found, is read out when it appears.
who: owners and front desk using a screen reader
fix_line: Mark the search result line so it is read out when it changes

items.reason: Buttons are real buttons with name labels on repeated Open, Check in and Undo; the pop-up keeps focus and closes on Escape; the QR has a spoken label; status words carry text, not colour only; light-look text colours read dark enough; dark look had 0 serious axe rules. Faults: arrow keys switch branches, three small tap targets, search results not announced, fixed pixel font sizes (same as the panel-wide finding). The entry-machine folder has no screen.

Code read, no screenshot in the inputs. The 'quiet' button style (no border, no fill, grey words) is used for I saved it and Open member on the paid-online card, Copy UPI ID, Hide QR, Copy link, Send on WhatsApp, Paste keys, Disconnect, Undo and Open on All branches: same fault as the existing finding.

Add a branch keeps the typed name when closed and the Add a branch button stays; Hide QR returns to the choices; Cancel on Paste keys returns to Paste keys; the moved notice only says OK. Faults: a failed or open payment link leaves no way back to the UPI QR or a retry; a cancelled link leaves no button (existing finding).
